analysis:
Examined both supplied excerpts and the bounded patch for docs/developer/test.md against the indexed threat model and detailed T-041. The visible change at head lines 1048–1059 replaces the dispatch-only, unsigned dev-release description with a dev-push caller of release-provider.yml using environment: dev and secrets: inherit, and documents Developer ID signing/notarization. This affects the release trust contracts associated with A-005, A-011, A-017, T-013 and T-054, but documentation alone does not establish unsafe secret access, artifact qualification or production registration. No independently supported regression was identified in these units.
The surrounding guide retains isolated test state, authenticated loopback qualification, bounded media/resource tests, cache encryption and explicit limits on qualification claims. No visible change weakens A-001/A-003 confidentiality, serving authorization, billing, cache scoping or availability controls. The date change at head line 3 is metadata only.
Integration must verify the documented dev trigger, inherited-secret guards, signing and publication separation against .github/workflows/release-dev-branch.yml and release-provider.yml and their tests. The complete range map also identifies changed head lines 1066–1078, whose contents are absent from these excerpts; they remain uncovered source for the next pass. These are coverage/contract uncertainties, not evidence of a vulnerability.
